decision.rationale: For each dataset, audited Phase 3 used the identical deterministic Phase-2 global window order, batch size, mixed-record batch membership, preprocessing, model revision and pooled CLS readout. Historical Phase-3 manifests report exact equality of same-forward CLS to the Phase-2 window cache. One shared per-dataset window bundle is therefore faithful; Phase-2 uses CLS and Phase-3 uses CLS plus Temporal Grid. HF Lung and BioCAS remain separate bundles because their record/window protocols differ.

common_model.preprocessing_scope: one call on each raw float32 waveform batch; min/max normalization is global over the complete batch tensor
common_model.temporal_grid_source: last_hidden_state[:,1:,:] from the same forward as CLS
common_model.temporal_grid_definition: [B,96,1024] -> [B,12,8,1024]; mean and population std (ddof=0) over the 8 mel positions; concatenate 12x1024 mean then 12x1024 std -> [B,24576]
common_model.determinism: no shuffle; fixed batch membership; no explicit deterministic-algorithms override in the audited producers

hf_lung_phase2.audio_loading: Python wave PCM decoder to float32; multichannel arithmetic mean
hf_lung_phase2.segmentation: eight fixed non-overlapping 2 s windows at [0,2),...,[14,16) seconds
hf_lung_phase2.padding: right-zero-pad every short window, including the 14-16 s window of each 15 s record
hf_lung_phase2.model_revision_evidence: functionally pinned by Phase-3 exact same-forward CLS equality

biocas_harmonised_phase2.record_order: included records in locked records.csv.gz row order
biocas_harmonised_phase2.audio_loading: Python wave PCM decoder to float32; multichannel arithmetic mean
biocas_harmonised_phase2.padding: right-zero-pad only the final incomplete window; exact multiples add no window
biocas_harmonised_phase2.device_evidence: canonical manifest records CUDA extraction; replay command selected an explicit CUDA device

storage.metadata: deterministic gzip CSV containing release-local record/group pseudonyms only
storage.runtime_role: regenerable intermediate cache for Full Reproduction
storage.dependency_policy: the public workflow must regenerate these features and must not depend on the validated internal cache
